title: The Half-Merged Dispatch Log
subject: DSA
briefing: Two sorted dispatch logs must be combined into one sorted timeline without losing any entries.
symptom: The merged log is ordered, but entries at the end of one log disappear.
hints: Inspect a case where one input becomes empty before the other.
The main loop stops when either pointer reaches the end. What remains in the other array?
There may be more than one unmerged value after the loop.
